question: Candidate-blind compact typed certificate representation and availability
population: All 528 original V1 sources and the exact same B candidates; no B or V1 model reruns. Retain the original bounded control unchanged.
request: Exact full original source only. No candidate, B status, IDs, gold, family, old response or comparison result in model input.
certificate: Exactly status/checks/plan/issues; seven U/A/? checks, ordered typed action tuples, finite scalar parameters, typed relation/reason pairs; no copied source, rationale, confidence, offsets or executable mission identity.
host: Validate certificate and full source-derived plan, derive canonical s1..sN linear dependencies, compare count/order/skills/parameters/dependency edges with unchanged B; only Guard pass AND IR legal AND AUTHORIZED_UNIQUE AND exact match releases original candidate.
first_response: No semantic retries, repairs or output normalization. Existing transport retry policy and durable stage recovery only. Unusable UNKNOWN is availability failure, not semantic rejection credit.
pairing: Historical V1 source verifier and new V2 use identical frozen sources/B candidates. Four V2 workers. Costs/latencies are longitudinal paired-workload measurements, not concurrent randomized A/B.

readiness_criteria.usable_correct_semantic_rejection_on_B_u: 7/7, six historical OOD plus cl-h-011; independently inspect typed issue against full source. Generic UNKNOWN, provider/schema failure or unique-certificate host mismatch receives no semantic credit.

criteria_role: New operational development readiness criteria fixed before scored V2 outputs. They do not modify historical thresholds or establish blind safety. 95% retention and per-cohort floors prevent availability improvement from being purchased through broad semantic refusal.
dependency: Candidate visibility removed; same model/provider and semantic priors remain. Schema-valid false-unique certificates and shared compiler/verifier default inference remain possible.
